channel.desc: Technology is not only becoming an increasingly important part of people's lives but also of the American economy. "Bloomberg Technology" takes a look at how the latest happenings in the tech industry are affecting the U.S. markets. The show, which was originally titled "Bloomberg West," is anchored by Emily Chang in San Francisco.
